name: manual_301c80
claim: A stale environment variable (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN) can shadow an otherwise-valid credential-manager login (gh's keyring auth), making a tool report 'invalid token' or 401 when the real, working credential is one env-unset away.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22/23: gh auth status showed 'Failed to log in using token (GITHUB_TOKEN) - the token is invalid' while a separate keyring-based login for the same account showed valid scopes but Active account: false. A prior session had already concluded gh auth was broken and needed manual operator retry -- it was actually a local env var shadowing a working credential the whole time. Fixed with 'env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh ...' for the specific invocation; both PRs opened cleanly afterward.
